card.name: Decimal point and ratio colon in concentrations
card.fires_on: The period after a leading 1 in specific gravity values and dilution volumes, and the colon in dilution ratios like 1:200. Weaker hits on scattered punctuation or linking words in other text.

modes.label: Decimal point after 1
modes.description: The period right after the digit 1 or 4 in a number such as specific gravity or dilution volume.
modes.example: The 1% concentration in saline solution has a specific gravity of 1<<.>>0060 to 1.

modes.label: Dilution ratio colon
modes.description: The colon in a ratio such as 1:200 describing a dilution.

modes.label: Scattered stray tokens
modes.description: Odd single tokens in citations and web text, with no shared theme.

card.writes: It lowers the chance that the next word is concentration, which fits a spot where a number is still being written.
card.plain: It fires on the decimal point or colon inside a number or dilution ratio, where the next thing is more digits.
